title: The Town That Stopped Receiving

features.name: silent junction
features.desc-on-touch: a circuit board hub where all the pathways end at once; you can still hear the hum of power with no carrier wave

features.name: antenna farm monument
features.desc-on-touch: three towers of stacked transmission equipment, all aimed at a sky that stopped answering; they are still trying

features.name: registry of last calls
features.desc-on-touch: a directory card filing cabinet where names appear and then vanish; you check for yours and find it there, dated today

features.name: lost frequency marker
features.desc-on-touch: a dark glyph showing the exact number of the channel that no longer broadcasts; you read it and forget it immediately

features.name: breath of the circuit
features.desc-on-touch: barely perceptible heat rising from the board; something here is still powered, still processing, still waiting

inscription: the town learned silence by losing the frequency that named it alive

file.name: LastSignalLog_1994_Corrupted.txt
file.note: final broadcast check from the altitude node; every response line says 'no signal' and then each one says something different

exits.label: back up the slope toward where the air remembers how to carry sound
toward a council chamber that still meets to discuss what the silence might mean
deeper into the country where settlements learned to exist without being named
